retrievalProfile.description: Generates high-contrast, grainy portraits with intentional motion blur and distorted facial expressions reminiscent of 90s lo-fi album covers.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait characterized by extreme film grain, harsh flash lighting, and a tilted, distorted facial expression that creates a sense of raw, unpolished energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast (bright skin vs. deep black)
coreInvariants: Heavy monochromatic film grain across the entire frame
Deep black negative space surrounding the subject
Harsh, direct flash lighting causing red-eye or high-key skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is positioned off-center, tilted at a 45-degree angle, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and the bright, distorted smile serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The diagonal tilt of the head leads the eye from the bottom left toward the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black background on the right and top edges creates a claustrophobic, focused feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, leaning into a muddy, analog feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and blacks

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with a tilted head and a wide, distorted smile. Use harsh direct flash lighting against a pitch-black background. Apply heavy film grain and slight motion blur to the facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, use a distressed sans-serif font with low opacity to match the lo-fi texture.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible and consistent?
Is the head tilted at an extreme angle?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the background is deep black
Ensure the lighting mimics a harsh camera flash
Confirm the subject's expression is distorted or blurred
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply [heavy film grain] + [harsh flash] + [45-degree tilt] to a [distorted facial expression] against [black negative space].
